title: Introduction to Death 101
description: A meditation on mortality, uncertainty, and the time you think you have left.

blocks.text: What would you do if you knew that you're gonna die in the next 10 year but you don't exactly know when... You just know it's within 10 years... Maybe it's tomorrow, maybe it's the last day of that 10th year...

items: to enjoy that possible 10 year of their life with having as much "fun" as possible and as much they can get out of their short life
or maybe get more grounded about afterlife and what would happen after I die (assuming you are a believer)
or maybe none of the above, idk

blocks.text: Now, what would you do, if you knew that you're gonna die within next 1 year but again, maybe today, maybe tomorrow or maybe at the 365th day mark...

how'd your circumstances change? Would you still be doing what you're doing? Or would perhaps start checking off your bucket list... Maybe that food or maybe that place you want to visit one last time.. or perhaps nothing..
What would you do if you knew, you're gonna die today, maybe at this exact hour, maybe this night, or, you could be looking at death right now... How'd you feel?

items: Are you really ready for death?
Do you know the exact moment when you're going to loose all your conscious and free will permanently forever?
Being born means death is inevitable, death should not be a taboo topic to talk about.
Is death really the end of everything? Or perhaps the start of everything?

blocks.text: What would happen to your choices of life if you knew that you're gonna die at the age of 60 or 80...
Are you going to relax and lay back a bit, maybe go on with your life ad you've been going on...
Just like you didn’t know whether you're gonna at this exact hour you're reading this or maybe tomorrow, you also don't know whether you're actually going to live to see 60 or 80...

items: Why do you live like you know for sure that you're gonna die at your 60s or 80s...

blocks.text: Would you change your circumstances even a little bit knowing and understanding the uncertainty your entire existence brings?

items: Does death not look at you from far apart and say I'm here for you.

blocks.text: Whether you find this uncomfortable or not, you cannot deny the fact that you're gonna die at an uncertain age at uncertain time that you don't have any idea of.

Do you really know for sure that you're gonna live to see the next sunrise? Are you 100% certain? Are you really? What if for one moment, just for the sake of this shenanigans, just imagine, you die today, at this very hour. At this moment..

items: If it does, why does it?
What is about death that you're so scared about?
What you need to have to not be scared of death?
Can death ever not be scary to you?
